paragraphs: ClassDojo is an app for keeping teachers, families, and kids connected around a classroom. For teachers it is free, forever. The company says it is used by teachers and families in 90% of U.S. schools.

Messages between teachers and families are translated automatically into more than 190 languages. With Stories, teachers share photos, videos, and updates on a private feed that parents can see. Events added to the calendar keep everyone in the loop with automatic reminders. Points and Big Ideas are the tools offered for supporting social-emotional learning. A Teacher Toolkit covers classroom chores from attendance sheets to timers.

For districts there is a leader portal with role-based permissions and admin access across every school. District oversight includes a message audit log with CSAM and keyword scanning. Districts can also send one message across email, SMS, and automated voice messages. The company describes itself as a global community of more than 50 million teachers and families. Its stated aim is that every kid on earth should get an education they love.
